# Conviso Platform Documentation

> Official product documentation for Conviso Platform, a cloud-based application security platform for risk-based vulnerability management, application security testing, threat modeling, AI-assisted workflows, and AppSec program operations.

The documentation is public and maintained in the open at https://github.com/convisoappsec/conviso-docs. Use the canonical URLs below when citing Conviso Platform capabilities. Product availability depends on the customer's plan and agreement.

## Start here

- [Conviso Platform documentation home](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/): Platform overview and documentation entry point.
- [Conviso Platform Evaluation Guide](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/before-you-buy): Plan a FDE-led proof of concept, including scope, technical validation, security review, and rollout decisions.
- [Conviso Platform product page](https://www.convisoappsec.com/conviso-platform): Product overview, use cases, and commercial information.
- [Pricing](https://www.convisoappsec.com/platform/pricing): Public plan and pricing information.
- [Contact Conviso](https://www.convisoappsec.com/contact): Talk to a Conviso AppSec specialist.

## Core capabilities

- [Risk and Posture Management](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/posture-management/posture): Risk posture, contextual prioritization, and remediation guidance.
- [Vulnerability Management](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/vulnerability-management/process): Finding lifecycle, triage, remediation, and validation.
- [Conviso AST](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/security-scans/conviso-ast/): SAST, SCA, IaC, SBOM, secret, and container analysis through the Conviso CLI.
- [Conviso DAST](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/security-scans/conviso-dast/): Dynamic testing for applications and APIs.
- [Security Gate](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/security-scans/security-gate): CI/CD security policy enforcement.
- [Threat Modeling](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/platform/threat-modeling): Security design workflows and requirements.
- [AI capabilities](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/platform/appsec-ai-agent): AI-assisted analysis, remediation, and security operations.
- [AI Pentest](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/ai-capabilities/ai-pentest): AI-driven penetration-testing workflow.

## Integration and automation

- [Integrations overview](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/integrations/integrations_intro): Source control, CI/CD, identity, collaboration, and security-tool integrations.
- [Conviso API](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/api/api-overview): GraphQL API for platform automation.
- [Conviso MCP Server](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/integrations/conviso-mcp-server): MCP access to Conviso Platform data and operations.
- [Conviso CLI](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/new-cli): Command-line access to Conviso Platform.

## Operations and trust

- [Data Retention](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/data-retention): Data retention and deletion practices.
- [Status Page](https://status.convisoappsec.com): Current service availability.
- [Release Notes](https://docs.convisoappsec.com/releases/): Product updates and release history.
